description: This file defines a base class for unit testing the WebAudioPlayer component, including setup, teardown, and helper methods for testing buffer management, timer behavior, and interactions with mocks.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerTestBase
classes.description: A base class providing setup, teardown, and helper methods for unit testing the WebAudioPlayer component.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerTestBase::createWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Initializes and creates a WebAudioPlayer instance with mocked dependencies.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerTestBase::destroyWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Cleans up and destroys the WebAudioPlayer instance, unmapping resources.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerTestBase::getBufferAvailableSuccess
methods.description: Checks that getBufferAvailable returns the expected number of frames and shared memory info.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerTestBase::writeBufferSuccess
methods.description: Simulates a successful buffer write operation.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerTestBase::expectWriteStoredFrames
methods.description: Sets expectations for writing stored frames to the buffer.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerTestBase::expectWriteNewFrames
methods.description: Sets expectations for writing new frames to the buffer.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerTestBase::expectStartTimer
methods.description: Sets expectation for starting a timer.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerTestBase::expectCancelTimer
methods.description: Sets expectation for canceling a timer.
